summary: Planka is a self-hosted Kanban/Trello-style project-management app (Sails.js + PostgreSQL) with users, projects, boards, lists, cards, tasks, comments, labels, attachments, custom fields, notifications, webhooks and 2FA sessions as persisted business entities.
